place.source_title: Hippodrome Theatre (Peoples Bank Theatre), Putnam Street

brief: Movie palace of 1919 remodelled in 1949 in Colonial Revival style: a painted-brick three-storey front with a front pediment and fanlight, a second-storey cast-iron porch, 9/6 windows, and a deep recessed entrance under a big marquee; red carpeted stairs and patterned tile in the lobby.

facade.notes: the Hippodrome / Peoples Bank Theatre (Marietta OH, 1919): a restored movie-palace entrance -- a projecting blade sign shaped as a shield, a lit marquee with changeable letters, red-painted glazed doors, a terrazzo entry floor with a border pattern

why.note: the theatre is all sign and marquee: the decorated shed of the 1910s-20s
